summary: Phase-6 testing of AI Video generation + Watermark feature. 47/47 backend pytest tests pass (added 9 new tests: watermark logo upload/get auth+success+non-image reject, generate-video auth+404, full generate->poll(ready_for_approval)->video/mp4 served->approve attaches to news item->re-approve 400, reject). Playwright E2E validated: login, Generate Video button, rendering spinner 'वीडियो रेंडर हो रहा है…', <video> preview appears with src=/api/images/samvad/video/*.mp4, Approve shows 'अनुमोदित · वेबसाइट पर लाइव', watermark logo upload in Scheduler modal (preview visible). RunPod stays MOCK (log line '[RunPod MOCK] start/stop GPU pod'); jobs flagged mocked=true. ffmpeg via imageio-ffmpeg produced ~16KB-220KB mp4s successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: run_video_job uses asyncio.create_task without any concurrency limit — if an admin spam-clicks Generate Video on many stories, multiple ffmpeg subprocesses can run in parallel and OOM the backend worker. Consider a semaphore (e.g. 2) or a job queue.

approve_video returns 400 for any status != ready_for_approval which also blocks re-approve on an already-approved job (currently tested). That's probably intended, but the error message 'Only a ready video can be approved' is misleading for the already-approved case — consider a distinct 409 or more specific text.
_render_mock_video uses subprocess.run without a timeout; a corrupt input could hang the worker thread indefinitely. Add timeout=60.
VideoJob.watermarked_image_url is persisted but never cleaned up on reject/regenerate — orphaned objects will accumulate in storage (same orphan issue as news images).

The 'approve' handler does not stop/clean an in-flight prior job if the admin clicks Regenerate from an approved state — a new processing job will update video_jobs for the same news_id but the GET /api/news/{id}/video endpoint only returns 'latest by created_at', so the previously-approved copy is still attached to the news item while a new job is in flight. That's probably fine but worth documenting.

RUNPOD_API_KEY/POD_ID defaulted to '' silently via os.environ.get — placeholder detection relies on startswith('REPLACE_WITH'), so any other non-empty string will attempt a real HTTP call. Consider explicit RUNPOD_MOCK=true toggle.
Watermark upload uses 6MB limit after full-read (same gap flagged in iter-5 for /api/upload-image).
Still open from prior: AdminDashboard.jsx > 720 lines, CORS_ORIGINS='*', no auth rate-limit.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Video tests take ~5-8s each (ffmpeg render). Watermark input is .hidden (dropzone pattern) — use `wait_for_selector(..., state='attached')` + `set_input_files` directly, do NOT wait for visible. Testids: video-panel-{id}, generate-video-btn-{id}, video-preview-{id}, approve-video-btn-{id}, reject-video-btn-{id}, regenerate-video-btn-{id}, watermark-logo-input, watermark-logo-preview, public-video-{id}. Public feed video rendering was not live-verified (no Published item with approved video existed at test time); verified via code review that PublicFeed.jsx line 98 renders <video data-testid=public-video-{lead.id}> whenever lead.video_url is present, and the backend approve flow attaches video_url to the news_item — so when an admin approves a video on a Published item it will appear on the lead. Regression surface (login, filters, scheduler, logout, add-news) remains functional (prev iter 100%).
